headline: Galy cultured cocoa hits pro kitchens; FDA salt-substitute rule; MOA egg replacer
summary: Galy is moving its cell-cultured cocoa from the US WunderHaus retail launch into professional kitchens, making it both a partnership candidate and a direct competitor for Belcolade in cocoa-free chocolate.

FDA will let salt substitutes be used in 139 standardised foods, including breads and rolls, from December 14, 2026, which opens a near-term sell-in window for Puratos salt-reduction solutions with North American bakers.
MOA Foodtech and Espiga I+D are partnering on egg replacement for bakery and cakes, a competitive signal for Patisserie's egg-replacement offer.
North American bakers are pushing fibre and protein (Grupo Bimbo, Calise, Rudi's gluten-free protein bread), so fibre and protein enrichment solutions have clear demand now.
Pressure on ultra-processed foods is building in US policy and media, raising the value of clean-label, fewer-additive bread and sweet-goods solutions.

items.title: Cultivated Cocoa Chocolate Lines: Galy Brings Lab-Grown Cocoa to Professional Kitchens
items.summary: Galy is bringing its cell-cultured cocoa chocolate lines to professional kitchens, extending its WunderHaus launch into foodservice.
items.why: Cultured cocoa reaching chefs and pastry kitchens puts Galy in direct reach of Belcolade's professional customers: a partnership target and a competitive threat to watch closely.

items.title: Rudi's launches gluten-free protein bread
items.summary: Rudi's has launched a gluten-free bread with 10 g protein and 3 g fibre per serving.
items.why: A US competitor product showing gluten-free bread moving into protein and fibre claims, a cue for Puratos gluten-free and protein-enrichment mixes.

items.title: Ferrero commits to high protein: Why is the confectionery giant investing in functional health?
items.summary: Ferrero is investing in high-protein confectionery, joining other confectioners moving into functional health.
items.why: A major chocolate player moving into high-protein treats signals demand for protein-enriched chocolate and fillings in Belcolade's market.

items.title: Managing Perceptions Around "Ultraprocessed" Foods
items.summary: Nutritional Outlook discusses how brands can manage consumer perceptions of 'ultraprocessed' foods.
items.why: Packaged bread and sweet-goods customers face growing ultraprocessed scrutiny; Puratos can position clean-label and fewer-ingredient solutions in response.

items.title: Daiya introduces Dairy-Free Cheesecake Bites
items.summary: Daiya has launched frozen dairy-free cheesecake bites in three flavours at Kroger, Sprouts and Meijer.
items.why: US retail is adding dairy-free cheesecake, a sign of demand for plant-based cream fillings and cheesecake bases in Patisserie.

items.title: The science and politics behind the panic over ultraprocessed foods
items.summary: An explainer on the science and politics behind concern over ultraprocessed foods.
items.why: Policy momentum on ultraprocessed foods could reach packaged bakery; keep clean-label reformulation options ready for customers.
